body:
lol so in fact there is more to this than meets the eye. It seems that its not the priority method that makes a difference - instead its the name of the Customizer. It seems like they are prioritized based on alphabetic order of classname. If you do a pull you will see some changes I made to your customizer:
```

@Singleton
public class ZMyCustomizer implements ObjectMapperCustomizer { // THIS ONE DOES NOT WORK
// public class AMyCustomizer implements ObjectMapperCustomizer { // THIS ONE WORKS

```

The name "RegisterCustomModuleCustomizer" I was using starts with R while yours started with "M" and that's what makes yours work!!!

That is sort of the case, but not exactly.

When the customizers don't change the priority, the default priority is set and then yeah, I guess the name comes into play implicitly.
But if you use the priority (which was added to address this type of situation), then you don't have to worry about the name.

> The name "RegisterCustomModuleCustomizer" I was using starts with R while yours started with "M" and that's what makes yours work!!!

~~No, that's not the case. If I remove the priority mine, doesn't work either~~

Scratch that, you might be on to something here. I see a case where mine fails as well even when the priority is applied.

Even with priority it fails if the class name is late in the alphabet:

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/26746221/107743040-d67b9c80-6d18-11eb-9c4f-5dea95039d38.png)
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/26746221/107743052-dd0a1400-6d18-11eb-8e23-356ebfb13ccb.png)
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/26746221/107743104-f612c500-6d18-11eb-9b63-a1d6fd175d09.png)
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/26746221/107743119-fd39d300-6d18-11eb-9216-9560dcf8d97f.png)

So the problem turns to be that the auto-generated customizer also uses the minimum priority and that causes the sort to fallback on the name.

Thanks for identifying the problem!

I'll add a fix ASAP

issue.title: Ensure that Jackson customizers can override settings added by Quarkus added modules

body:
https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/pull/15027 takes care of the problem.

Thanks again for the vigilance!
